Setting.Name: D724::TenantGuard::Enabled
Setting.Description: Enables default-deny tenant authorization for D724 services.

Setting.Name: D724::TenantGuard::AllowPlatformAdmin
Setting.Description: Allows platform administrators to cross tenant boundaries. Keep disabled except for controlled emergency access.

Setting.Name: D724::TenantGuard::PolicyVersion
Setting.Description: Identifies the active tenant policy contract for audit records.

Setting.Name: D724::TenantCache::Enabled
Setting.Description: Enables policy-bound tenant namespace cache operations.

Setting.Name: D724::TenantCache::MaximumTTLSeconds
Setting.Description: Maximum TTL accepted by the tenant cache adapter.
